summary: All five phases delivered their planned objectives. Phase-01 is fully conformant. Phases 02 and 03 have justified cascading deviations driven by TypeScript's structural type system: adding required fields to shared interfaces forced updates to resolveReviewPolicy.ts and ~36 test-fixture files across the suite, all explained in their handoffs. Phase-04 achieved its objective (subcommand registered, hook wired, settings builder and tests present) but deviates on file routing (program.ts used instead of planned main.ts) and touches three unplanned files (introspect.ts, scripts/generate-usage-spec.ts, cliProgram.test.ts) with no handoff produced to justify or explain them. Phase-05 delivered the security doc but the .agents/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md edit exists only in the working tree, not committed; the handoff clearly flags this as a required follow-up.

findings.message: src/domain/security/resolveReviewPolicy.ts was touched but not planned. This file also returns SecurityPolicy; adding allowWriteProtected as a required field to the interface forced an update. Hardcoded to [] (review phase never grants protected writes). Justified in handoff.

tests/unit/security/resolvePolicy.test.ts was touched but not planned. Existing ResolvedSecurityConfig fixture literals were missing the new required allowWriteProtected field; TypeScript enforced the update. No logic changed. Justified in handoff.

src/schemas/securityPosture.ts was touched but not planned. The plan stated 'if schema-validated, update that schema too'; SecurityPosture is schema-validated and required the new approvedProtectedPaths field. Justified in handoff as within the stated conditional scope.

Approximately 36 test files were touched but not planned (integration and unit test suites). Required-field additions from phases 01-02 (allowWriteProtected on ResolvedSecurityConfig and SecurityPolicy) and from phase-03 (approvedProtectedPaths on SecurityPosture) forced fixture updates across the test suite. No logic changed in any of those files. Comprehensively justified in handoff.

No phase-handoff.md was produced for phase-04. The plan's required handoff content (settings file path/name, hook shape, path-passing mechanism, hidden subcommand name, confirmation that empty approvals leave invocation unchanged) is entirely absent from the record.

src/cli/main.ts was planned but not touched. The hidden subcommand (__approve-protected-path) was registered in src/cli/program.ts (line 390) instead. The objective is met through an equivalent file; program.ts is the actual CLI program builder. Not justified in writing due to missing handoff.
src/cli/program.ts was touched but not planned. This is where the subcommand was registered instead of main.ts. No handoff justification available.
src/cli/introspect.ts was touched but not planned. Purpose unknown — no handoff produced. Requires operator inspection before merge.
scripts/generate-usage-spec.ts was touched but not planned. Purpose unknown — no handoff produced. Requires operator inspection before merge.
tests/integration/cliProgram.test.ts was touched but not planned. Likely covers CLI program structure changes from the subcommand registration. No handoff to confirm scope.

.agents/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md is planned-to-edit but marked missing in reconciliation. The edit (protected-path guidance subsection) was performed in-session but not committed — phax took the commit snapshot before the formatter's final pass. The edit exists in the working tree. Handoff clearly acknowledges this and calls out a required follow-up commit on main.

Confirm that src/cli/program.ts is the correct registration point for hidden subcommands in this CLI (used instead of planned main.ts); update future plan templates if so.
pointers: Possible test-coverage gap: phase-04 added tests/integration/cliProgram.test.ts (unplanned) — confirm it covers the __approve-protected-path subcommand registration and not just general program wiring, since the planned tests/unit/claudeArgs.test.ts (optional) may not have been touched.

Possible edge case in decideProtectedPathApproval: the phase-01 handoff states path comparison requires path.posix.isAbsolute(filePath); confirm claudeCode.ts passes the absolute path from the Claude hook payload without re-resolving relative to the worktree root.
